name: Inaba Hiroshi
source:
Inaba Hiroshi had to leave his home as a child and live in an orphanage due to his family-related problems. When he heard that his father became seriously ill, he came back to Tokiwa village on the night of Tanabata (Star Festival). During that night, Hiroshi met a [url=https://vndb.org/c3129]mysterious girl[/url] that is holding a black stuffed cat-like toy. The strange girl wearing black clothes and a black hat doesn't remember her own name but none of that will stop Hiroshi from spending more time with the girl and her stuffed cat, [url=https://vndb.org/c3370]Archimedes[/url]. Hiroshi's special summer like none other in Tokiwa has just began.

[Edited from [url=http://www.mangagamer.com/detail.php?product_code=43]MangaGamer[/url]]
